prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D pixel-art RPG animation sprite sheet for the referenced ORIGINAL blue-robed archmage. Match navy star-speckled pointed hood, silver embroidered hems, gold front rune stole, sapphire brooch/shoulder jewels, brown book and potion at belt, slim ivory staff crowned by large cyan crystal. Mature human male, no beard. True transparent background, no checkerboard, text, labels, cell lines or ground shadows. Precisely 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 separate full-body poses, generous transparent gutters, consistent body size and feet baseline within each cell. Each sprite including staff tip and magic must fit wholly in its own cell. Row1 four distinct walking frames alternating feet/robe swing. Row2 four attack frames: gather cyan magic, extend free palm, small ice projectile release, recover. Row3 first two cells support spell channel and release with small cyan ring; final two cells recoil hit and recovering. Maintain SAME facing direction in EVERY cell including casts, no turning toward viewer. Compact magic effects, no huge circles obscuring feet. Crisp detailed pixels, dark contour, readable at 48px, orthographic slight top-down game camera. Reference sheets guide clothing and pose only; do not reproduce their checker backgrounds or text. All twelve poses face toward screen bottom, front three-quarter view.
